summary.root_cause_text: v1.4 'faster batch writer' in ledger sync job writes ledger amounts 100x the order amount (cents/units bug).
recommended: Fix the batch writer's amount scaling and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying v1.4
queue_max change 1000->1500 looks unrelated and was left as is
